headline: BLS E-Services shares face selling pressure ahead of stock split record date
summary: BLS E-Services Limited shares saw downward pressure ahead of its upcoming stock split and dividend record date. The IT services firm has announced a 1:2 stock split alongside a final dividend of ₹0.50 per share. The stock closed at ₹322.05, maintaining a market capitalization of ₹2,926.03 crore after gaining 56% over the period. Retail investors holding the stock will see their share count double and face a price adjustment following the corporate action.
whats_next: Stock split and dividend record date
why_it_matters: Share price adjusts as holdings double and dividend payout nears

headline: BLS e-Services and Veranda Learning set record dates for stock split and spin-off
hook: Final hours to buy before corporate action
summary: BLS e-Services and Veranda Learning Solutions have scheduled their stock split and spin-off record dates for October 6. Investors aiming to qualify for these corporate actions must purchase the shares by Monday, October 5. This adjustment alters the share price and volume structure for existing holders. Retail investors holding these stocks must complete trades today to be included in the registry.
why_it_matters: Qualify for corporate actions by buying before today's deadline

headline: Ten stocks including NMDC and BLS E-Services turn ex-record date this week
hook: Ten corporate actions hitting record dates
summary: Ten companies have set their record dates this week for corporate actions such as bonus issues, stock splits, and dividends. Firms participating include NMDC, BLS E-Services, GTV Engineering, PTC India, Shankara Buildpro, and Mold-Tek Technologies. Eligible shareholders as of the record date will receive the respective corporate benefits. Retail investors holding these stocks should verify their holdings ahead of the ex-date.
whats_next: Ex-date trading for the listed stocks this week
why_it_matters: Verify shareholdings before ex-dates to qualify for corporate benefits

headline: Four small-cap companies announce stock splits scheduled for October 2026
hook: Upcoming October split calendar for four small-caps
summary: BLS E-Services, Shankara Buildpro, Bansal Wire Industries, and JSW Dulux have announced stock splits set for October 2026. The corporate actions will adjust share counts and face values for shareholders. The underlying companies report varied financial growth amid rising input costs and market headwinds. Retail investors holding these stocks will see their share quantities adjusted according to the announced ratios on the record dates.
whats_next: October 2026 record dates for the respective stock splits
why_it_matters: Share holdings multiply automatically without changing total investment value.

headline: BLS International Services reports resignation of its statutory auditor
hook: Auditor departure at BLS International Services
summary: BLS International Services Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding the resignation of its statutory auditor. The company has not yet detailed the specific reasons behind the auditor's exit or named a replacement. Further disclosures from the company are expected regarding the appointment of a new audit firm. Indian retail investors should monitor subsequent filings for any potential governance concerns or delays in financial reporting.
whats_next: Appointment of a new statutory auditor by BLS International
why_it_matters: Auditor exits can signal governance risks or reporting delays.
winners_losers: BLS shareholders hurt / new auditor gains
